scope: What is still missing before JANUS/TRUMP could legitimately claim SAT in P and therefore P=NP.

internal_evidence.key_fact: Narrow articulation cut states can prevent flat-boundary explosion on the frozen chain, but the next unresolved parameter is growing separator/state width.
Search-order reversal is executable and replayable, but the frozen witnesses terminated before cap-dependent differences became binding.
Portable exact state lineage works on frozen scope, but exhaustive fallback verification grows as 2^n in that backend and cumulative deferred debt must be globally bounded.

external_constraints.reference: Darwiche & Marquis, A Knowledge Compilation Map
external_constraints.lesson: A representation is not useful merely because it is succinct: the required queries and transformations must also be polynomial-time.

external_constraints.reference: Vinall-Smeeth, IJCAI 2024, Structured d-DNNF Is Not Closed under Negation
external_constraints.lesson: Structured d-DNNF does not generally support polynomial-time negation, disjunction, or existential quantification, so one compact language cannot be assumed to remain cheap under every operation TRUMP needs.

external_constraints.reference: Amarilli, Monet, Senellart, Connecting Width and Structure in Knowledge Compilation
external_constraints.lesson: For bounded-arity/degree monotone CNF/DNF, OBDD width is exponential in pathwidth and d-SDNNF size exponential in treewidth up to the stated parameter factors. Raw structural width therefore cannot simply be wished away.

gap_nodes.statement: For every arbitrary CNF input F of length n, deterministically find an exact next transition or exact terminal without an unbounded search/oracle, and prove that the transition sequence terminates after poly(n) paid work.
gap_nodes.why_blocking: Finite success, portfolio success, reverse scheduling, and frozen-family coverage do not imply total arbitrary-input coverage.

gap_nodes.statement: Handle separator/state width w that grows with input size without paying 2^w, either by proving a polynomially bounded exact semantic state or by discovering another exact representation whose total lifecycle is polynomial.
gap_nodes.why_blocking: BCEG v8 succeeds because the live articulation state remains narrow; v8 itself names growing separator width as the next frontier.
gap_nodes.forbidden_shortcut: Assume all arbitrary CNFs have O(log n) effective width without proof.

gap_nodes.statement: Given arbitrary F, discover the right certificate language, decomposition, separator, macro, representation switch, or elimination chain in poly(n), not merely prove that a compact object exists after exponential search.
gap_nodes.why_blocking: Gold Slime, RBLGANUL, TOPA, reverse reading and PvP can govern exploration, but discovery priority is not proof and hidden exponential candidate search would destroy SAT-in-P.

gap_nodes.statement: Every representation used along the successful path must support the exact operations actually required next, or have a deterministic polynomial-cost certified escape to another representation that does.
required_accounting: COUNT or witness reconstruction when invoked
gap_nodes.why_blocking: Knowledge-compilation tradeoffs and known non-closure results rule out assuming one compact representation stays polynomial under every transformation.

gap_nodes.statement: Prove one polynomial p(n) bounding the sum of all discovery, compilation, representation growth, switching, verification, replay, canonicalization, certificate generation, witness recovery, and deferred debt across the entire run.
gap_nodes.why_blocking: Per-step cheapness does not imply a cheap lifecycle; MK-BCEG R4 explicitly demonstrated cumulative-debt failure.

gap_nodes.statement: Replace any exponential semantic-enumeration fallback with polynomial-size proof objects and a checker whose paid cost is polynomial in input/proof size for every accepted transition and final SAT/UNSAT terminal.
gap_nodes.why_blocking: The R4 fallback verifier checks 2^n assignments by construction; that backend cannot certify a polynomial end-to-end theorem.

gap_nodes.statement: Define a well-founded progress measure Phi such that every nonterminal arbitrary-CNF state has a certified move decreasing Phi and the number/total cost of decreases is polynomially bounded.
gap_nodes.why_blocking: A local strict progress gate is insufficient if no move exists at some state or if there are exponentially many valid decreases.

gap_nodes.statement: Express every bound in the actual bit length n of the encoded CNF/proof state and prove arithmetic/data-structure operations are polynomial in that encoding size.
gap_nodes.why_blocking: A bound polynomial in a numeric magnitude, state-count surrogate, or experimentally bounded parameter can still be exponential in input bit length.

gap_nodes.statement: Assemble the preceding lemmas into a deterministic exact algorithm deciding every CNF-SAT instance in polynomial time, with SAT witnesses and UNSAT correctness independently checkable, then invoke the standard NP-completeness reduction consequence.
gap_nodes.why_blocking: Only this converts successful mechanisms into SAT in P; finite experiments cannot substitute for the theorem.

topa_spider_priority.note: TRUMP R2 can reveal where cap choice matters, but the theorem-critical frontier is still universal semantic cut/state compression plus polynomial discovery/lifecycle accounting.

recommended_next_experiment.goal: Separate raw Boolean separator width from exact semantic state complexity on growing-width families, with hidden low-semantic-dimension positives and hostile controls whose semantic dimension also grows.
recommended_next_experiment.killer_control: Include families where known restricted structured representations require exponential width/size, so success cannot come from silently reusing a low-width easy class.
recommended_next_experiment.promotion_rule: Finite success may establish a typed-class lemma only. Arbitrary-CNF P=NP promotion remains forbidden until G1-G9 are proved.
